name: Equivalence Queries Complexity of Addressing
proof: Restrict here to $n=2^r$ with all r-bit words present, so $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor=\log_2n=r$. The established equality $\mathrm{Q}_{\mathrm{eq}}=\mathrm{Ldim}$ reduces this to the Littlestone-dimension value for Addressing.
details: Scope: complete-code subfamily $n=2^r$, $r\ge1$. The displayed formula is not asserted for arbitrary injective encodings at other n.
